prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1094; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with pain and swelling of the left wrist. Imaging confirmed a distal radius fracture with mild dorsal displacement. The fracture was managed initially with closed reduction and a short-arm cast, followed by serial radiographs to monitor alignment and healing.

Over the course of 21 visits, the patient was seen for orthopedic follow-up, cast checks, and progressive rehabilitation. Pain and swelling improved steadily, and radiographs showed appropriate callus formation without loss of reduction. Once union was clinically and radiographically established, the cast was removed and the patient began a structured occupational therapy program focusing on range of motion, grip strength, and functional use of the hand.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported minimal residual pain with activity, near-full wrist flexion and extension, and grip strength approaching the uninjured side. Some stiffness with heavy lifting persists. Continued home exercise and periodic reassessment are recommended. Prognosis for full functional recovery is good.
